integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md and independent exact-rational finite checker in check.py; finite checks corroborate, but do not prove, the all-size theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three distinct real type values, all positive multiplicities; at most two coalitions, free sizes, singleton cost zero. No claim for four or more distinct types or fixed cardinalities. Unindexed equivalent clustering work remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact sorted optimum for three-valued average-distance coalitions
